title: Agility Ladder Quick Feet
description: Players run through an agility ladder using several footwork patterns to build quick, precise foot speed with no ball involved.

content.objective: Build quick, accurate foot placement through a repeatable ladder pattern.
content.setup: An agility ladder is laid flat on the floor; players queue at one end.
instructions: Run through the ladder with one foot in each square for the first pass.
Run through with two feet in each square for the second pass.
Run through laterally, facing sideways, for the third pass.
Rest and repeat the full sequence twice more.
coachingPoints: Stay on the balls of the feet throughout.
Pump the arms to match the quick foot rhythm.
Prioritise accuracy over speed for the first few reps.
commonMistakes: Looking down at the feet instead of looking ahead.
Clipping the ladder rungs by rushing the pattern.
Standing up tall instead of staying low through the movement.
content.safety: Make sure the ladder is flat and secured so it doesn't slide underfoot.
